nodes.source_status: papers/core/majorana/the_majorana_problem.md record MAJ-C16 claims COMPUTATIONALLY_CHECKED; audited status COMPUTATIONALLY_CHECKED
nodes.statement: On the 6x6 tetron torus (V = 36, E = 72, dim H1 = 2, rank d0 = 35) a weight-one residual classifies OpenObstruction within a 100 ms test bound in Rust and Python, and the full coset 2^35 exceeds the 2^20 search budget.
nodes.bottleneck: The body's 17 ms figure is not recorded in this checkout; the timed residual exits at the syndrome step, so the elimination step is not timed; timing is machine-dependent.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/majorana/the_majorana_problem.md record MAJ-C17 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status PROVED_PROSE
nodes.statement: For v with entries in {0, 1} and p >= 1, the sum of |v_i|^p equals wt(v), so l1 and l2^2 coset minimizations over F2 have identical objectives and minimizers; dim H1 >= 2 gives distinct logical classes, not a norm gap.
nodes.bottleneck: The Lean declaration does not state this identity; a Lean lemma over p-th powers of 0/1 entries is absent.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/majorana/the_majorana_problem.md record MAJ-C1 claims DEFINITION; audited status DEFINITION
nodes.statement: The Majorana problem is the gap between continuum open-system device narratives (nanowires, zero-bias peaks, interferometric parity readout) and declared finite algebraic schedules (F2 cochain homology, Ising matrices): neither discharges the verification conditions of the other without an explicit realization map.
nodes.bottleneck: A validated realization map from a device to a declared complex is not supplied by this source.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/majorana/the_majorana_problem.md record MAJ-DEF-DETECTOR-INADEQUATE claims DEFINITION; audited status DEFINITION
nodes.statement: A measurement projection M is DETECTOR_INADEQUATE for a hypothesis pair when two distinct candidate states have the same readout (rho1 - rho2 in ker M), so the protocol cannot discriminate them.
nodes.bottleneck: Which laboratory maps M are adequate is the open program MAJ-OPEN-EVIDENCE-ADEQUACY.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/majorana/the_majorana_problem.md record MAJ-COMP-SYNDROME-READOUT claims COMPUTATIONALLY_CHECKED; audited status COMPUTATIONALLY_CHECKED
nodes.statement: On the 2x2 tetron torus the column and row logical representatives are distinct cochains with equal zero syndrome d1 w, so the readout M(w) = d1 w is DETECTOR_INADEQUATE for them.
nodes.bottleneck: Fixed instance; the adequacy of a syndrome-plus-class readout is asserted, not computed.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/majorana/the_majorana_problem.md record MAJ-C10 claims DEFINITION; audited status DEFINITION
nodes.statement: Device baths, continuum BdG spectra, fabrication narratives, conductance peaks 2e^2/h, gap protocols and capacitance shifts C_Q are external observer projections: they may motivate which complex to declare but do not populate F2 receipts or mint authority without a validated realization map.
nodes.bottleneck: A realization map that would lift this quarantine is not supplied.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/majorana/the_majorana_problem.md record MAJ-FENCE-NONCLAIMS claims DEFINITION; audited status DEFINITION
nodes.statement: The source makes no claim of physical MZM detection, vendor endorsement, FOC terminal identity, a generic FSP solution, a complete topological gate set from Ising braiding, an l1-vs-l2 separation over F2, unbounded exact syndrome decoding, physical tetron hardware, or falsity of external measurements.
nodes.bottleneck: Each non-claim is a scope rule; none is a theorem.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/majorana/the_majorana_problem.md record MAJ-C6 claims DEFINITION; audited status IMPORTED_ASSUMPTION
nodes.statement: The spinless p-wave Kitaev chain H = -sum(t c_j^dag c_{j+1} + Delta c_j c_{j+1} + h.c.) - mu sum(c_j^dag c_j - 1/2), its BdG spectrum, the phase region |mu| < 2t with Delta nonzero, and the sweet-spot form H = -i t sum gamma_{2j} gamma_{2j+1} with free edge modes gamma_1, gamma_{2L} are imported models.
imported_structure: Kitaev 2001 chain Hamiltonian and topological phase table
nodes.bottleneck: No statement that a physical wire realizes this Hamiltonian without disorder or trivial subgap states is made or supported.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/majorana/the_majorana_problem.md record MAJ-KITAEV-EDGE-INDEX claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status PROVED_LEAN
nodes.statement: For every bond (u, v) = (2j, 2j+1) with 1 <= j < L, u and v differ from 1 and from 2L.
nodes.bottleneck: Index-level statement only; operator commutation [H, gamma_1] = 0 is the exact instance MAJ-KITAEV-SWEETSPOT-EXACT.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/majorana/the_majorana_problem.md record MAJ-KITAEV-SWEETSPOT-EXACT claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status COMPUTATIONALLY_CHECKED
nodes.statement: On the exact Gaussian-rational 2-mode Fock carrier with t = Delta = 1, mu = 0, the Kitaev Hamiltonian is Hermitian, commutes with fermion parity, commutes with gamma_1 and gamma_4, and the bulk invariant is -1.
nodes.bottleneck: Fixed L = 2 instance; general L and the BdG spectrum remain imported.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/majorana/the_majorana_problem.md record MAJ-C7 claims DEFINITION; audited status IMPORTED_ASSUMPTION
nodes.statement: The Ising model {1, sigma, psi} with sigma x sigma = 1 + psi, sigma x psi = sigma, psi x psi = 1 and the R, F data R = e^{-i pi/8} diag(1, i), F = (1/sqrt2)[[1,1],[1,-1]] on the four-sigma fusion space are imported; Ising braiding alone yields only Clifford operations, classically simulable by Gottesman-Knill, so magic-state inputs are required for a complete gate set.
imported_structure: Ising anyon fusion, F and R data (Nayak et al. 2008)
Clifford-only braiding and Gottesman-Knill simulability
nodes.bottleneck: No claim of physical anyon braiding is made; the braid-matrix identities are the open check MAJ-ISING-BRAID-CHECK.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/majorana/the_majorana_problem.md record MAJ-ISING-BRAID-CHECK claims COMPUTATIONALLY_CHECKED; audited status OPEN
nodes.statement: For B1 = R and B2 = F R F over Q(zeta16), B1 B2 B1 = B2 B1 B2, F^2 = I and the hexagon equations hold as exact identities.
nodes.bottleneck: Run the identities in exact cyclotomic arithmetic; the paper code checks only Yang-Baxter in floating point.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/majorana/the_majorana_problem.md record MAJ-MAJORANA-BRAID-YB claims COMPUTATIONALLY_CHECKED; audited status COMPUTATIONALLY_CHECKED
nodes.statement: For 3 to 10 Majoranas the exact signed-permutation exchange action satisfies b_i b_{i+1} b_i = b_{i+1} b_i b_{i+1}, far commutativity, and composition with its inverse gives the identity.
nodes.bottleneck: Fixed counts 3..10; this is the Majorana exchange action, not the Ising 2x2 representation.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/majorana/the_majorana_problem.md record MAJ-C8 claims DEFINITION; audited status DEFINITION
nodes.statement: That a Z2 parity operator squares to I and commutes with an effective Hamiltonian is checked as an algebraic property of declared finite matrices; capacitance shifts C_Q and reflectometry signals stay external models and do not establish protection or coherence.
nodes.bottleneck: No experimental readout model is derived.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/majorana/the_majorana_problem.md record MAJ-PARITY-SECTOR-EXACT claims COMPUTATIONALLY_CHECKED; audited status COMPUTATIONALLY_CHECKED
nodes.statement: On the exact 2-mode Fock carrier the parity operator restricts to 2-dimensional even and odd sectors, and restricting gamma_1 to a sector is refused because it mixes sectors.
nodes.bottleneck: Fixed 2-mode instance; the paper code's ParityAlgebraModel check is floating point.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/majorana/the_majorana_problem.md record MAJ-GIN-INVOLUTION-CANCEL claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status PROVED_LEAN
nodes.statement: For a natural weight w and integer signs with s1 + s2 = 0, w s1 + w s2 = 0 in Int.
nodes.bottleneck: Single pair only; no global involution on a configuration space is constructed.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/majorana/the_majorana_problem.md record MAJ-GIN-ROUTING claims DEFINITION; audited status DEFINITION
nodes.statement: evaluate_gin_fermion_recovery routes an invalid index to ClosureFailure, a valid index with zero uncancelled sign mass to Repair, and positive mass to SplitBrainRefusal.
nodes.bottleneck: The three lemmas unfold this rule; the Repair label is a routing tag, not a sign-problem solution.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/majorana/the_majorana_problem.md record MAJ-C18 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status OPEN
nodes.statement: For four MZMs under a Lindblad braiding model with gap Delta, length L/xi and poisoning rate Gamma_qp > 0, the trace-norm transfer defect obeys Delta_transfer(T) <= min(1, C_LZ (hbar/(Delta T))^2 + (Delta/hbar) e^{-L/xi} T + 1 - e^{-Gamma_qp T}) for T >> hbar/Delta, and that envelope has a positive minimum.
imported_structure: Lindblad master equation with poisoning and dephasing channels
Landau-Zener leakage asymptotics
nodes.bottleneck: Derive the envelope from the Lindblad equation; a positive physical lower bound on Delta_transfer needs an independent argument, as the source notes.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/majorana/the_majorana_problem.md record MAJ-C19 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status OPEN
nodes.statement: For a bath J(w) = 2 pi alpha w_c^{1-s} w^s e^{-w/w_c}, the envelope C_LZ (hbar/(Delta T))^2 + A_s T^p has minimizer T* = (2 C_LZ hbar^2 / (p A_s Delta^2))^{1/(p+2)}, a positive minimum for alpha > 0, and exponent beta = 2/(p+2).
imported_structure: structured bosonic bath spectral density (Leggett et al. 1987)
nodes.bottleneck: Derive the bath term A_s T^p and p(s) from the spectral density; the calculus minimization of the stated envelope is not written out.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/majorana/the_majorana_problem.md record MAJ-C20 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status OPEN
nodes.statement: For an M-terminal junction (M >= 4) with Delta_eff = Delta_0 (1 - sigma_V/sigma_crit), the transfer envelope adds C(M,2) >= 6 pairwise splitting channels, its minimum rises with sigma_V on (0, sigma_crit), and the gap closes for sigma_V >= sigma_crit.
imported_structure: linear gap-degradation model Delta_eff(sigma_V)
exponential overlap splitting delta E_ij
nodes.bottleneck: Derive the envelope and the monotonicity in sigma_V; the gap-degradation law is posited.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/majorana/the_majorana_problem.md record MAJ-LEAN-ENVELOPE-NAT claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status PROVED_LEAN
nodes.statement: Over Nat: products and sums of positive naturals are positive, p > 0 gives p + 2 > 0, p > q gives p + 2 > q + 2, M >= 4 gives M (M - 1) / 2 > 0, and a > b gives a - b > 0.
nodes.bottleneck: These lemmas do not bear on any physical envelope; MAJ-C18..C20 stay open.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/majorana/the_majorana_problem.md record MAJ-OPEN-LP-DUAL-CEILING claims OPEN; audited status OPEN
nodes.statement: Exact rational l1 linear programming with dual certificates may give certified lower bounds on the F2 coset weight, certifying cosets beyond the search budget where they meet the capped upper bound and reporting the gap otherwise.
nodes.bottleneck: No LP relaxation or dual certificate for the F2 coset weight is implemented in this source.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/majorana/the_majorana_problem.md record MAJ-OPEN-EVIDENCE-ADEQUACY claims OPEN; audited status OPEN
nodes.statement: Whether a declared laboratory protocol's measurement map M separates topological zero modes from trivial Andreev bound states, i.e. whether rho_topo - rho_ABS lies outside ker M.
nodes.bottleneck: Requires a declared device model and measurement map; none is supplied.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/majorana/the_majorana_problem.md record MAJ-OPEN-POISSON-SCHRODINGER claims OPEN; audited status OPEN
nodes.statement: A self-consistent 3D Poisson-Schrodinger solver coupling gate geometry, dielectric screening and subband chemical-potential pinning to evaluate phase-boundary shrinkage in multi-terminal junctions.
nodes.bottleneck: Listed as the next test; no solver exists in this checkout.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-018 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status PROVED_PROSE
nodes.statement: On an admitted N-dimensional complex inner-product space V with orthonormal basis e_i, creation c_i^dagger = e_i wedge - and interior annihilation c_i on the exterior algebra of V (dimension 2^N) satisfy {c_i, c_j} = 0 and {c_i, c_j^dagger} = delta_ij; in particular (c_i)^2 = 0.
imported_structure: complex mode space V with inner product (admitted)
exterior Fock space as the carrier for fermionic states (admitted)
nodes.bottleneck: Mechanize the CAR identities on the exterior algebra; the statistics choice (exterior versus symmetric algebra) is an admitted postulate, and identifying modes with spin-1/2 particles needs the relativistic spin-statistics theorem, outside this finite setting.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-019 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status COMPUTATIONALLY_CHECKED
nodes.statement: In the increasing occupation ordering on 6 modes, the sign of the hop c_target^dagger c_source on every occupation bitmask equals the product of the Jordan-Wigner parities of the annihilation and the creation step, checked exhaustively over all 2^6 states and ordered mode pairs.
imported_structure: Jordan-Wigner mapping between spin-1/2 Pauli operators and CAR operators (standard literature result)
nodes.bottleneck: The general Jordan-Wigner bijection c_j = (prod_{k<j} -sigma^z_k) sigma^-_j between spin-1/2 chains and CAR operators is a standard result imported here, not derived or mechanized in this checkout.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-020 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status IMPORTED_ASSUMPTION
nodes.statement: For N CAR modes, gamma_{2j-1} = c_j + c_j^dagger and gamma_{2j} = -i(c_j - c_j^dagger) are self-adjoint with {gamma_a, gamma_b} = 2 delta_ab, generate the Clifford algebra on 2N generators, and P = prod_j (-i gamma_{2j-1} gamma_{2j}) is the fermion parity (-1)^N_op.
imported_structure: Majorana operator decomposition of CAR modes (standard literature result)
fermion parity superselection (physical postulate)
nodes.bottleneck: Standard algebra imported, not derived here; the trunk mechanizes only the two-generator case (DS-QM212-MAJORANA-PROBLEM). Parity superselection is a physical postulate, not a consequence of the algebra.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-021 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status PROVED_PROSE
nodes.statement: The CAR constrain the operators c_i, not the Hamiltonian: H = 0, free hopping -t sum c_i^dagger c_j and the Hubbard H(t, U) are distinct Hermitian number-conserving operators on the same CAR Fock space, so a physical Hamiltonian is an added admission (explicit 2-site Hubbard matrix computed by hand).
imported_structure: Hermitian Hamiltonian H = H^dagger (admitted)
particle-number conservation [H, N] = 0 (admitted)
locality graph and real hopping t (admitted)
Hubbard on-site interaction U (admitted)
nodes.bottleneck: Hermiticity, number conservation, a locality graph, a one- and two-body truncation and the interaction U remain explicit admissions in every downstream sign record.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-022 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status PROVED_PROSE
nodes.statement: For a finite self-adjoint H with H_xx = V_x, H_xy = -a_xy (-1)^{eps_xy} (a_xy > 0, eps symmetric), beta >= 0 and E* >= max V_x, Z = e^{-beta E*} sum_m beta^m/m! sum over closed length-m configuration paths of prod K_{x_{j+1} x_j} with K = E* I - H, and each nonzero closed term has sign (-1)^{sum of eps along the path}.
imported_structure: positive edge magnitudes a_xy, parities eps_xy and diagonal energies V_x on an orthonormal configuration basis (supplied; ledger ORIGIN-001)
nodes.bottleneck: The sign of a closed term is a property of the supplied magnitudes, parities and representation; vertex sign gauges remove all negative entries exactly when every configuration cycle is even (FSP-SWITCHING-NORMAL-FORM). Trotter slicing and its error are separate.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-023 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status DEFINITION
nodes.statement: For a declared path representation with weights W(c), <Sign> = Z / Z_abs with Z = sum sigma(c)|W(c)| and Z_abs = sum |W(c)|; when Z > 0, Delta f := -(1/(beta N)) log <Sign> >= 0, so <Sign> = exp(-beta N Delta f) holds by definition.
imported_structure: declared path representation (basis and operator expansion)
nodes.bottleneck: Exponential decay in beta N is a hypothesis (Delta f bounded below by a positive constant uniformly in N and beta), not a theorem; Z_abs is an operational absolute ensemble, not in general a physical bosonic system.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-024 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status PROVED_PROSE
nodes.statement: For M_s independent samples from |W|/Z_abs, the sign mean has variance (1 - <Sign>^2)/M_s, so relative error epsilon needs M_s >= (1 - <Sign>^2)/(epsilon^2 <Sign>^2); if <Sign> = exp(-beta N Delta f) this is Omega(exp(2 beta N Delta f)).
imported_structure: independent sampling from the absolute-weight distribution (assumption)
nodes.bottleneck: Correlated Markov-chain samples, observable numerators and the extensive-gap hypothesis need separate treatment; this bound concerns direct reweighting only, not every estimator or representation.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-025 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status COMPUTATIONALLY_CHECKED
nodes.statement: For the 3-site spinless triangle, t = 1, U = 0, two fermions, beta = 2 and three Euler slices, the occupation-basis expansion has 27 paths, 6 negative of weight 8/27 and positive weights in {4/9, 1}, so no equal-weight pairing exists there; in the one-body eigenbasis H is diagonal with E in {-1, -1, 2} and Z = 2e^2 + e^-4.
nodes.bottleneck: Frustration alone does not imply disjoint weight spectra or hardness (ledger GIN-C4, INV-DISJOINT-SPEC); the general Lean lemma covers only the step from disjoint spectra to no weight-preserving sign-reversing involution.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-026 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status IMPORTED_ASSUMPTION
nodes.statement: Troyer-Wiese (2005): the NP-complete decision whether a 3D +-J Ising spin glass has ground energy below a threshold reduces in polynomial time to estimating the thermal energy of the frustrated quantum model -sum J_ij sigma^x_i sigma^x_j at beta J >= N ln 2 + ln(12N); a deterministic polynomial estimator for that family would give P = NP, a randomized one NP subset of BPP.
imported_structure: Troyer and Wiese, PRL 94, 170201 (2005), cond-mat/0408370, equations (10)-(11) and footnote 9
NP-completeness of the 3D Ising spin-glass ground-state decision problem (Barahona)
nodes.bottleneck: This is a worst-case statement about a model family under a precision promise; it is not formalized here, is not a reduction to the Hubbard model, and does not make any fixed finite system or every fermionic Hamiltonian intractable.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-027 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status PROVED_LEAN
nodes.statement: For any carrier with weights in N and signs +-1, an involution tau with w(tau c) = w(c) and sign(tau c) = -sign(c) has no fixed point and each pair satisfies w(c) sign(c) + w(tau c) sign(tau c) = 0; zero signed sum does not require such a pairing (+2, -1, -1), and a cancelling doublet can carry a nonzero observable numerator.
imported_structure: supplied weight-preserving sign-reversing involution
nodes.bottleneck: Summing pairs to get sum_c w(c) sign(c) = 0 on a finite set is a prose orbit-partition step (manuscript Section 4.2), not mechanized; observable numerators need A o tau = A; the involution is sufficient, not necessary (INV-INVOL-CANC).

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-029 claims COMPUTATIONALLY_CHECKED; audited status COMPUTATIONALLY_CHECKED
nodes.statement: For the four-site periodic ring, U = 0, two spin-up fermions, beta = 3/2 and four Euler slices, all 32 negative Euler-transfer paths are matched to disjoint positive paths of exactly equal rational weight within one weight fiber, and a posting-list query over k modes uses k posting-list operations.
nodes.bottleneck: Pairing is on exact weight fibers of enumerated paths, not a spectator-preserving symmetry (INV-GIN-PARITY); it does not preserve general observables, and path enumeration grows exponentially. CT-AUX update stability for multi-orbital models has no evidence here.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-030 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status PROVED_PROSE
nodes.statement: For d0 in Q^{m x n} and W = im d0, N_W(x) = x - sum_i x_{p_i} r_i (nonzero RREF rows r_i of d0^T with pivots p_i) is sound, idempotent and complete for x ~ y iff x - y in W, and is independent of the generating matrix; Lean checks the three laws for the fixed integral image span(1, 2) in Z^2.
imported_structure: fixed rational coboundary matrix d0 and coordinate order
nodes.bottleneck: N_W is not an l1 minimizer (span(1,2), x = (1,0) gives norm 2 versus 1); the quotient norm is a separate exact linear program with a refusal budget (NF-003). A valid YAML contract or routing label is not a normalizer.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-032 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status IMPORTED_ASSUMPTION
nodes.statement: With link phases U_ij = exp(i A_ij) and oriented plaquette products U_p, the Wilson action S = beta_g sum_p (1 - Re U_p) is invariant under local U(1) gauge transformations and nonnegative.
imported_structure: compact lattice U(1) gauge theory with Wilson action (Wilson 1974)
nodes.bottleneck: Standard lattice-gauge fact imported, not established in this checkout; the source supplies no fermion-sign consequence for it.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-033 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status IMPORTED_ASSUMPTION
nodes.statement: The Wilson-Dirac operator satisfies gamma5 D_W gamma5 = D_W^dagger, so its nonreal eigenvalues come in conjugate pairs and det D_W is real; for two degenerate flavors det(D_W)^2 >= 0.
imported_structure: Wilson-Dirac lattice fermion operator with r = 1 (standard lattice QCD)
nodes.bottleneck: A single-flavor det D_W can be negative; the JSONL claim that det D_W is nonnegative is only the two-flavor square. Not established in this checkout.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-034 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status IMPORTED_ASSUMPTION
nodes.statement: Adding S_theta = i theta Q_top with real lattice charge Q_top multiplies the Boltzmann weight by exp(-i theta Q_top), which is nonreal unless theta Q_top lies in pi Z for every configuration, so positive-weight importance sampling is lost for generic theta != 0.
imported_structure: lattice topological charge Q_top and theta vacuum term (standard)
nodes.bottleneck: Severity of the resulting sign problem is phenomenology from the literature; the checkout has no theta-term model.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-035 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status OPEN
nodes.statement: Claimed: on a finite slab lattice the chiral variation of the boundary fermion determinant cancels the bulk Chern-Simons variation; no lattice construction or cancellation computation exists in this checkout.
imported_structure: Callan-Harvey continuum anomaly inflow (literature)
nodes.bottleneck: Construct a finite slab Dirac operator, compute both variations and show cancellation; the continuum Callan-Harvey mechanism is literature, its finite-lattice form is not established here.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-036 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status IMPORTED_ASSUMPTION
nodes.statement: For lattice SU(2) with Dirac fermions in the real adjoint representation, an antiunitary symmetry of the Dirac operator makes det D_adj real for every gauge configuration.
imported_structure: lattice SU(2) gauge theory with adjoint Dirac fermions (standard)
nodes.bottleneck: For a single Majorana adjoint flavor the measure is a Pfaffian whose sign can change; reality is not positivity. Not established in this checkout.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-037 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status IMPORTED_ASSUMPTION
nodes.statement: For lattice Dirac operators with chemical potential, gamma5 D(mu) gamma5 = D(-mu*)^dagger, hence det D(mu)^* = det D(-mu*); for real mu != 0 this relates D(mu) to D(-mu) only and det D(mu) is in general complex.
imported_structure: lattice QCD with staggered quarks at chemical potential (standard)
nodes.bottleneck: Standard identity imported; the checkout has no SU(3) staggered operator and no computation of det D(mu).

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-038 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status OPEN
nodes.statement: Claimed: averaging over Z3 center phases cancels the signs of fractional-triality quark paths and leaves color-singlet zero-triality contributions; no model, projection identity or computation for this exists in this checkout.
nodes.bottleneck: State the canonical-ensemble center projection as an identity on a declared lattice model and show which signs it removes; ledger GIN-C10 and GIN-C11 withdraw the fixture reading.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-039 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status IMPORTED_ASSUMPTION
nodes.statement: At mu = i mu_I with real mu_I, gamma5 D(i mu_I) gamma5 = D(i mu_I)^dagger, so det D(i mu_I) is real; nonnegativity needs two degenerate flavors (or a staggered operator m + K with K anti-Hermitian, m > 0), and Z(mu_I) has Roberge-Weiss periodicity 2 pi T / 3.
imported_structure: imaginary chemical potential and Roberge-Weiss periodicity (literature)
nodes.bottleneck: Analytic continuation from imaginary to real mu is an extrapolation, not a sign-free route to real mu; not established in this checkout.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-040 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status OPEN
nodes.statement: Claimed: a finite-lattice 2D N=1 Wess-Zumino model with supercharges obeying {Q_a, Q_b} = 2 delta_ab H, H >= 0 and exact boson-fermion pairing of nonzero levels; no such lattice construction exists in this checkout, and lattice discretizations generally keep at most a subalgebra exact.
nodes.bottleneck: Specify the lattice model and which supercharge is exact; prove H = Q^2 or {Q, Q^dagger} on the finite Hilbert space before using pairing.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-041 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status OPEN
nodes.statement: Claimed: on an off-shell supersymmetric lattice model the map xi = -partial^2 phi + W'(phi) has Jacobian equal to the fermion determinant and turns the partition function into a Gaussian with no sign problem; nothing in this checkout constructs the map or the Jacobian identity.
nodes.bottleneck: Give the lattice model, prove det(d xi / d phi) = det D_F, and treat the sign of det D_F and the multiplicity of the map; Nicolai-map results are model specific in the literature.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-042 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status IMPORTED_ASSUMPTION
nodes.statement: On a finite-dimensional graded Hilbert space with an exact supercharge Q and H = {Q, Q^dagger}, positive-energy levels pair bosons with fermions, so W = Tr[(-1)^F exp(-beta H)] = n_B(E=0) - n_F(E=0) for every beta, and unbroken supersymmetry has ground energy 0.
imported_structure: exact supercharge with H = {Q, Q^dagger} on a finite graded space (assumption)
nodes.bottleneck: Standard result imported; it presupposes an exact lattice supercharge, which FSP-DERIV-040 leaves open, and gives no sign-free sampling of Z itself.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-043 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status IMPORTED_ASSUMPTION
nodes.statement: Kitaev (2006): in the four-Majorana representation of the honeycomb model, the plaquette fluxes W_p commute with H and with each other, and in each flux sector H is quadratic in the c Majoranas with a static Z2 gauge field (after projection to the physical subspace).
imported_structure: Kitaev honeycomb spin model and its Majorana representation (Kitaev 2006)
nodes.bottleneck: A sign-free sampling claim for this representation is not made or checked here; the gauge projection and flux-sector sum must be kept explicit.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-044 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status IMPORTED_ASSUMPTION
nodes.statement: Arovas-Schrieffer-Wilczek: adiabatic exchange of two quasiholes in the nu = 1/m Laughlin state gives statistical phase theta = pi/m.
imported_structure: Laughlin nu = 1/m state and quasihole Berry phase (literature)
nodes.bottleneck: No Berry-phase or torus computation is in this checkout; the local module fixes m = 3 and checks numeric constants only (ledger GIN-C16 withdraws its reading).

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-045 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status IMPORTED_ASSUMPTION
nodes.statement: The Fibonacci category has fusion tau x tau = 1 + tau, quantum dimension d_tau = (1 + sqrt 5)/2 (irrational), F and R matrices solving the pentagon and hexagon equations, and three-anyon braids generate a dense subgroup of SU(2) (Freedman-Larsen-Wang).
imported_structure: Fibonacci modular tensor category data (literature)
nodes.bottleneck: The JSONL calls d_tau rational, which is false; the claim that braiding avoids sign degradation has no content here. Exact ribbon data are pinned elsewhere in the trunk (TFQ-0050), not in this package.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-046 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status OPEN
nodes.statement: Claimed: in BF theory on finite cell complexes, the Postnikov class in H^3(G, A) governs cancellation of higher 2-group sign anomalies on knotted worldsheets; no BF model, linking computation or cancellation identity exists in this checkout.
nodes.bottleneck: Define the finite BF or 2-group gauge model, compute the 3-loop braiding phases and state exactly which weights become nonnegative; ledger GIN-C19 to GIN-C21 withdraw the fixture readings.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-047 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status OPEN
nodes.statement: Claimed: a 4D boundary fermion theory with nontrivial invariant exp(2 pi i eta) in Omega_5^Spin(B Z2) has an unremovable sign problem curable only by a 5D bulk; no computation of the bordism group, eta invariant or sign obstruction exists in this checkout.
nodes.bottleneck: Relate the anomaly invariant to the sign of a declared finite representation and rule out every representation in a stated class; anomaly-based intrinsic sign results in the literature are class specific.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-048 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status IMPORTED_ASSUMPTION
nodes.statement: On a 4D triangulation with squared edge lengths, the deficit angle at a hinge h is epsilon_h = 2 pi - sum of dihedral angles at h and the Regge action is S = sum_h A_h epsilon_h; its convergence to the Einstein-Hilbert action under refinement is a literature result imported here.
imported_structure: Regge calculus (Regge 1961; Cheeger-Mueller-Schrader convergence)
nodes.bottleneck: Regge calculus carries no fermion-sign content in this package; Lorentzian signature, convergence conditions and any sign consequence need separate evidence (ledger GIN-C13).

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-049 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status OPEN
nodes.statement: Claimed: a discrete Wheeler-DeWitt operator H_perp on spatial triangulations is nonnegative and acts as a projection on diffeomorphism-invariant states; no such operator is constructed here, and the DeWitt supermetric of the continuum constraint is indefinite.
nodes.bottleneck: Construct H_perp on a declared finite state space and determine its spectrum; the manuscript separates the constraint H_perp Psi = 0 from thermal Hamiltonians (Section 2.5).

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-050 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status OPEN
nodes.statement: Claimed: a discrete topological partition function on 4D triangulations is invariant under the 1-5, 2-4 and 3-3 Pachner moves; the source names no state-sum model, and the Regge action itself is not Pachner invariant.
nodes.bottleneck: Fix a state-sum model (for example a Crane-Yetter type sum) and check its move invariance; nothing here bears on fermion signs.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-051 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status OPEN
nodes.statement: Claimed: a global proper-time foliation in CDT forbids spatial branching, removes Lorentzian cancellations, yields a sign-free positive transfer matrix and a 4D de Sitter universe; the de Sitter phase is numerical literature and the checkout has no transfer-matrix or positivity computation.
nodes.bottleneck: Positivity in CDT uses a Wick rotation of a declared action; derive it for a declared finite model and keep numerical phase results as external evidence.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-052 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status OPEN
nodes.statement: Claimed: Dirac-Kaehler fermions on simplicial lattices give 2^(D/2) flavors and EPRL-FK boundary contractions yield nonnegative spin-network weights; the only local content is the count 1+4+6+4+1 = 16 = 4 x 4 in D = 4, and no spinfoam amplitude is evaluated.
nodes.bottleneck: Evaluate EPRL-FK boundary contractions on a declared finite complex and determine their signs; the taste count is standard and carries no positivity.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-053 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status IMPORTED_ASSUMPTION
nodes.statement: Vijay-Haah-Fu (2016): the X-cube model on an Lx x Ly x Lz periodic cubic lattice has pairwise commuting vertex and cube terms and ground-state degeneracy 2^(2Lx + 2Ly + 2Lz - 3).
imported_structure: X-cube stabilizer model (Vijay, Haah, Fu 2016)
nodes.bottleneck: Imported literature result; the checkout has no X-cube stabilizer computation, and it has no fermion-sign consequence by itself.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-054 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status IMPORTED_ASSUMPTION
nodes.statement: In the X-cube model isolated fractons are immobile, fracton dipoles move within planes (planons) and lineons move only along lattice axes.
imported_structure: X-cube excitation mobility (literature)
nodes.bottleneck: The claim that these constraints suppress sign-inducing braids has no evidence here and is left open.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-055 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status OPEN
nodes.statement: Claimed: lineons confined to 1D hinge lines cannot exchange without collision, so their worldlines carry no nontrivial permutations and foliated fracton models are sign free; no model, path expansion or sign computation exists in this checkout.
nodes.bottleneck: Give a fermionic fracton Hamiltonian, its declared representation and show all path weights nonnegative, including lineons on intersecting hinges; ledger GIN-C24 withdraws the fixture reading.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/fsp/theory_of_finite_fsp.jsonl record FSP-DERIV-056 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status REFUTED
nodes.statement: The claimed dichotomy (each finite quantum system either admits a certified sign-eliminating involution found in polynomial time or is an NP-hard sign obstruction) fails as stated: NP-hardness is a property of input families, the free triangle has no equal-weight involution in its declared basis yet is solved by one-body diagonalization, and zero signed mass need not come from an involution.
nodes.bottleneck: The open research content is FSP-EFFICIENT-SAMPLING-OBLIGATIONS: for a stated model family and input encoding, separate exact finite identities, protected sign-free representations, efficient samplers and worst-case hardness.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/mub6/theory_of_finite_mub6.jsonl record MUB6-DERIV-051 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status DEFINITION
nodes.statement: Fix the identification C^6 = C^2 tensor C^3 with product basis |j,k> = |j> tensor |k> for j in {0,1} and k in {0,1,2}; this is a declared choice of tensor factorization of the six-dimensional carrier.
imported_structure: Hilbert tensor product C^2 tensor C^3 (GP-IMPORT-TENSOR-PRODUCT)
nodes.bottleneck: The source statement that every 6x6 operator decomposes into Pauli and Gell-Mann tensor products, and its SU(2)/SU(3) reading, are not checked here; the factorization selects no MUB structure.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/mub6/theory_of_finite_mub6.jsonl record MUB6-DERIV-052 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status IMPORTED_ASSUMPTION
nodes.statement: No finite field has six elements, since finite fields have prime-power order; hence the finite-field Weyl-character construction of d+1 MUBs has no instance at d = 6.
imported_structure: Finite fields have prime-power order (standard algebra; not instantiated at order 6 in this checkout)
nodes.bottleneck: This rules out one construction route only; it gives no upper bound on the number of MUBs in C^6 and does not exclude a complete family produced by another construction.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/mub6/theory_of_finite_mub6.jsonl record MUB6-DERIV-053 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status IMPORTED_ASSUMPTION
nodes.statement: On C^6 with shift X|j> = |j+1 mod 6> and clock Z|j> = w^j |j>, w = exp(2 pi i/6), one has Z X = w X Z, and the 36 operators X^p Z^q are pairwise orthogonal for the trace pairing tr(A* B).
imported_structure: Weyl-Heisenberg commutation and Hilbert-Schmidt orthogonality of displacement operators (standard)
nodes.bottleneck: These standard identities are not checked in this checkout for d = 6; the source writes X Z = w Z X, which holds only under the opposite clock convention; no MUB count follows from them.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/mub6/theory_of_finite_mub6.jsonl record MUB6-DERIV-054 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status OPEN
nodes.statement: Claim: maximal commuting classes of the Weyl-Heisenberg group over Z_6 do not partition the 35 non-identity displacement classes and yield at most three MUBs in C^6.
nodes.bottleneck: Give the exact stabilizer-class statement with a cited proof or an exact enumeration; even then it bounds only Weyl-Heisenberg constructions, not arbitrary MUBs.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/mub6/theory_of_finite_mub6.jsonl record MUB6-DERIV-056 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status PROVED_LEAN
nodes.statement: A quartet of pairwise unbiased orthonormal bases of C^6 exists iff some 6x6 matrix H has a raw quartet: H, U, V with unit-modulus entries, M* M = 6I, and |(A* B)_ij|^2 = 6 for each pair; raw-quartet existence is invariant under row and column permutation-phase equivalence.
nodes.bottleneck: Global exclusion still needs complete representative coverage and nonextension for every representative, which no_quartet_of_concrete_representatives takes as hypotheses.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/mub6/theory_of_finite_mub6.jsonl record MUB6-DERIV-057 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status PROVED_LEAN
nodes.statement: For unit phases a, b, c the explicit matrix fourierDitaMatrix(a,b,c), built from w = exp(2 pi i/3) blocks with rows signed by a, b, c, has unit-modulus entries and H H* = 6I.
nodes.bottleneck: The defect value 4 of F_6, the equivalence F_6 ~ F_2 tensor F_3, the Jaming et al. nonextension theorem for this family, and exhaustion of the Fourier orbit by the displayed matrices are cited or open, not formalized here.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/mub6/theory_of_finite_mub6.jsonl record MUB6-DERIV-058 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status PROVED_LEAN
nodes.statement: The explicit 6x6 matrix haagerupMatrix with entries in {1, -1, i} has unit-modulus entries and H H* = 6I.
nodes.bottleneck: The source one-parameter family H6(q) without 2x2 or 3x3 Hadamard sub-blocks is not constructed; matching this matrix to the Haagerup source and to any exclusion theorem is an open step.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/mub6/theory_of_finite_mub6.jsonl record MUB6-DERIV-059 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status PROVED_LEAN
nodes.statement: For unit phase triples a, b with a0 a2* + a1 a0* + a2 a1* + b0 b2* + b1 b0* + b2 b1* = 0, the block matrix [[A, B], [B*, -A*]] of circulants has H H* = 6I and H/sqrt 6 is unitary with squared entry moduli 1/6; alpha is in both phase-sum images x + y + conj(xy) and -alpha iff some real solution of the six parameter equations has first phase sum alpha.
nodes.bottleneck: Transport to a dephased representative, classification of arbitrary CHM(6), the source cusp rank-degeneration claim, and Conjecture 3 (no quartet contains a family member) are not established.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/mub6/theory_of_finite_mub6.jsonl record MUB6-DERIV-060 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status PROVED_LEAN
nodes.statement: For unit phases x, y the explicit matrix karlssonMatrix(x,y), with rows built from +-1, w, w^2 (w = exp(2 pi i/3)) and the phases x, y, has unit-modulus entries and H H* = 6I.
nodes.bottleneck: No equivalence to the full three-parameter Karlsson family is supplied; the source claim that the CHM(6) moduli space has real dimension at most 4 with a finite chart cover is open.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/mub6/theory_of_finite_mub6.jsonl record MUB6-DERIV-061 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status PROVED_LEAN
nodes.statement: The Tao matrix S6 with entries in {1, w, w^2}, w = exp(2 pi i/3), has unit-modulus entries and S6 S6* = 6I.
nodes.bottleneck: The source claims that S6 is isolated and that the CHM(6) moduli space is disconnected are cited literature facts, not formalized here.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/mub6/theory_of_finite_mub6.jsonl record MUB6-DERIV-062 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status REFUTED
nodes.statement: Refuted claim: no affine family through F_2 tensor F_3 contains a third basis unbiased to both the identity and the base matrix; the product triple I_6, F_2 tensor F_3 / sqrt 6, and A_2 tensor C_2 (itself row-phase equivalent to F_2 tensor F_3) is pairwise unbiased.
nodes.bottleneck: Affine-fiber stratification of CHM(6) is not formalized; the counterexample is the exact SymPy check of the product triple recorded at MUB6-DERIV-063.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/mub6/theory_of_finite_mub6.jsonl record MUB6-DERIV-063 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status COMPUTATIONALLY_CHECKED
nodes.statement: The bases U_r = A_r tensor C_r (r = 0, 1, 2) of C^6, with A_r = I, F_2, [[1,1],[i,-i]]/sqrt 2 and C_r = I, F_3, diag(1,w,w) F_3, are unitary and pairwise unbiased with squared overlaps 1/6, so C^6 has at least three MUBs.
nodes.bottleneck: This fixed triple is not the source triad {I_6, F_6, B_3} with a dephased circulant B_3, which is not checked; a fourth basis for any triple remains open (MUB6-GLOBAL-OBLIGATIONS).

nodes.source_status: papers/core/mub6/theory_of_finite_mub6.jsonl record MUB6-DERIV-064 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status PROVED_LEAN
nodes.statement: For a fixed triple T of complex 6x6 matrices and a candidate U in 72 real coordinates, each MU residual equals tr(P_{T_a,i} P_{U,j}) - 1/6, and the real zero set of the 108 MU and 72 orthonormality residuals is empty iff no U has U* U = I and |<T_a,i, U_j>|^2 = 1/6 for all a, i, j.
nodes.bottleneck: Emptiness is not established for any MU triple or uniformly over a family; a complete seven-basis family would make the variety of its first three bases nonempty (family_triple_variety_nonempty).

nodes.source_status: papers/core/mub6/theory_of_finite_mub6.jsonl record MUB6-DERIV-065 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status PROVED_LEAN
nodes.statement: The fixed-triple system indexes exactly 180 real constraints in 72 coordinates: 108 MU residuals (36 per basis of the triple) and 72 real and imaginary components of U* U - I; the count is not an independence or dimension claim.
nodes.bottleneck: The source split (36 normalization, 36 against I_6, 108 against F_6 and B_3) does not match the Lean indexing; no rank or overdetermination statement is established.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/mub6/theory_of_finite_mub6.jsonl record MUB6-DERIV-066 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status OPEN
nodes.statement: Claim: a real Nullstellensatz certificate for the 180-residual ideal forces the Gram matrix of the 24 vectors of a putative quartet {I_6, F_6, B_3, B_4} to have a negative eigenvalue, so the variety is empty.
nodes.bottleneck: No such certificate, Gram computation or emptiness proof is in the checkout; variety emptiness is the open part of gap G5.

nodes.source_status: papers/core/mub6/theory_of_finite_mub6.jsonl record MUB6-DERIV-067 claims PROVED_LEAN; audited status OPEN
nodes.statement: Claim: Groebner elimination ideals of the 180-residual ideal on coordinate slices yield contradictory univariate polynomials, so the solution variety has no isolated points.
nodes.bottleneck: No Groebner basis computation, elimination certificate or replay is in the checkout; the gap registry lists elimination over Q(zeta_24) only as an open approach to G1.
